CA.name: Prickly rose
CA.citation: US Forest Service Fire Effects Information System (FEIS); pictured on Alberta licence plates since 1983; Alberta's provincial flower

CN.name: 刺薏薇
CN.citation: Flora of China (efloras.org, the authoritative national flora); Flora Reipublicae Popularis Sinicae; Chinese Academy of Sciences iPlant.cn database. Distinguished from the separate species Rosa davurica (山刺玫)

FI.name: Karjalanruusu
FI.citation: Suomen Lajitietokeskus (Finnish Biodiversity Information Facility); Finnish Rose Society species registry with full botanical description; genus-level list confirms clear distinction from Koiranruusu (R. canina) and Kurtturuusu (R. rugosa)

JP.name: オオタカネバラ
JP.citation: YList (BG Plants Japanese name-scientific name index), the standard Japanese botanical nomenclature authority; Japanese Wikipedia. Explicitly distinguished from the closely related Japanese-endemic species Rosa nipponensis (タカネバラ)

KR.name: 인가목
KR.citation: National Institute of Biological Resources, Republic of Korea (species.nibr.go.kr)

RU.name: Шиповник иглистый
RU.citation: Russian Wikipedia dedicated species article; Moscow State University Botanical Garden herbarium database, specimens documented across Siberia, Kamchatka and Yakutia; Plantarium.ru

SE.name: Finnros
SE.citation: Swedish Wikipedia dedicated species article; genuine garden cultivation confirmed in Sweden

US.name: Prickly rose
US.citation: US Forest Service Fire Effects Information System (FEIS); Wikipedia. Also documented as bristly rose, wild rose, Arctic rose
